meta.title: Database browser
meta.description: A DBeaver-style database panel in the sidebar. Manage MySQL, TDSQL (MySQL and PG flavors), GoldenDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Redis connections, browse schemas and tables, run SQL in an editor, and inspect Redis keys. Connection types are vendor-specific and a feature matrix trims the UI to what each vendor supports (TDSQL and GoldenDB have no stored procedures, so that entry stays hidden); vendors with procedures can browse and execute them (execution needs allowWrites). Every started connection keeps a persistent connection pool shared by the panel and the agent. Redis supports standalone, Sentinel, and Cluster deployments; SQL connections accept multiple hosts for failover. The same operations are exposed to the agent through the db_browser and redis_browser tools, so the agent can inspect data on request. Connections are read-only by default (SELECT/SHOW/DESC/EXPLAIN and read-only Redis commands); set allowWrites: true in the plugin configuration to enable writes. Passwords are stored in the credential store, never in configuration. Open the panel from the database icon in the sidebar's panel list.
